papers.title_en: Simply Stabilizing the Loop via Fully Looped Transformer
papers.authors: Rao Fu, Zixuan Yang, Jiankun Zhang, Jing Ma, Hechang Chen, Yu Li, Yi Chang
papers.evidence: 循环 Transformer 迭代复用同一批模块
papers.tldr: 循环 Transformer 通过迭代复用同一批模块以额外计算换取性能提升，且不增加参数与上下文长度，但循环次数增多时训练会失稳。作者分析发现失稳源于梯度振荡与残差爆炸两个原因，并提出全循环 Transformer，引入两项无参数修改加以抑制。实验表明该设计可在更深的循环下稳定训练，并借助可调循环次数在推理期平衡性能与测试时计算。该工作为循环层复用的可扩展训练提供了实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Scaling model performance typically requires increasing model size. Looped Transformer offers a compelling alternative by iteratively reusing the same Transformer blocks, trading additional computation for improved performance without increasing parameter count or context length. Because the number of loop iterations can be adjusted at inference, it also provides a natural mechanism for balancing performance and test-time compute. However, Looped Transformer still suffers from training instability when the number of loop iterations increases. Our analysis reveals that this instability stems from two sources: gradient oscillation and residual explosion. To address these two problems, we propose the Fully Looped Transformer, which introduces two parameter-free modifications: (1) Fully Looped Architecture, which distributes inter-loop signals across all layers to mitigate residual explosion; (2) Attention Injection, which reuses the existing attention block to suppress gradient oscillation. These modifications stabilize training dynamics, enabling the Fully Looped Transformer to be trained stably up to 12 loop iterations, whereas other baseline looped models collapse in this regime. In milder settings where Looped Transformer does not collapse, Fully Looped Transformer still improves average downstream-task performance by up to 13.2\%. Overall, our experiments demonstrate that Fully Looped Transformer improves training stability, enhances downstream performance, and provides preliminary adaptability under different test-time compute budgets by varying loop iterations at inference.

papers.title_en: A Dual-Path Architecture for Scaling Compute and Capacity in LLMs
papers.authors: Markus Frey, Behzad Shomali, Joachim Koehler, Mehdi Ali
papers.evidence: 循环 Transformer 双路径块与共享深层子层
papers.tldr: 该文指出循环 Transformer 虽能以共享块重复计算提升参数效率，但在固定浮点运算量下容量低于基线 Transformer。作者提出双路径块，在同一层中并行设置重复 K 次的共享参数深层子层和只执行一次的宽前馈网络子层，并用逐词元门控组合两条路径。实验在两个浮点运算量预算下验证该结构可同时扩展计算与容量，为循环大语言模型架构设计提供新方案。
papers.abstract_en: Looped transformers apply a shared block multiple times and have emerged as a parameter-efficient route to scaling compute in language models. However, at fixed FLOPs a looped model has strictly less capacity than a baseline transformer. We propose a novel dual-path block that can flexibly scale compute, the number of sequential operations applied to a hidden state, and capacity, the parameters available at a single step. For this we expose both axes as parallel pathways within a single layer: a deep sublayer re-applied K times with shared parameters, and a wide sublayer with an enlarged feed-forward network applied once. Independent per-token gates combine both axes and allow detailed per-token routing analyses. We show that across two FLOP budgets, our dual-path model surpasses iso-FLOP matched models on language modeling and downstream evaluations, while using fewer parameters than the baseline at matched FLOPs. The learned gates are directly interpretable and show systematic per-token allocation with function words and lexical content trend wide, while punctuation, symbols, and arithmetic tokens trend deep.

papers.title_en: CART: Context-Anchored Recurrent Transformer -- A Parameter-Efficient Architecture with Learned Stability
papers.authors: Chad A. Capps
papers.evidence: 在参数高效语言模型中沿深度复用单个共享核心块R次
papers.tldr: 针对现有循环Transformer每次迭代都重算键值张量、递归稳定性难以保证的问题，作者提出CART架构：由多层前奏一次性计算K与V，循环核心通过多头潜在注意力交叉关注冻结张量，并用可学习线性时不变门控维持稳定。在单张消费级GPU上经64组筛选和36组完整训练，门控谱半径稳定落在0.79至0.83的窄带内。该工作说明上下文锚定加门控可在共享单块参数下实现稳定且参数高效的循环语言模型。
papers.abstract_en: We present CART (Context-Anchored Recurrent Transformer), a parameter-efficient language model that reuses a single shared core block R times across depth. Unlike prior looped transformers that recompute key-value tensors at every iteration, CART computes K and V once from a multi-layer prelude and has the recurrent core cross-attend to those frozen tensors via multi-head latent attention. A learned Linear Time-Invariant (LTI) gate keeps the recurrence stable: its spectral radius settles in a narrow band (rho in [0.79, 0.83]) across all 36 fully-trained configurations. We evaluate CART on single consumer GPUs in two stages: a 64-configuration screen at 3,000 steps, then 36 configurations (P=6, R in {6,8,10}, three seeds) trained for 30,500 steps (~1B tokens). Two patterns hold across widths d in {256,512,768,1024}: prelude depth P dominates loop count R, and the Stage-1 ranking of R reverses at full training (R=6 becomes best at d>=512). At the binding d=1024 parameter-parity test, CART does not beat a parameter-matched dense baseline, losing by 1-2% at stored-parameter parity and by ~10% at effective-parameter parity. Diagnostic ablations split the effective-parameter gap into ~5% from weight sharing and a residual ~5% from the heterogeneous prelude/anchor/core/coda framing; the recurrent-core machinery (hyper-connections, LTI gate, loop-index embedding) is individually vestigial. Variable-R inference degrades on both sides of the trained R, a negative result for test-time depth scaling under this recipe.

papers.title_en: Shared Weights, Selected Computations: How Looped Transformers Route What Each Loop Does
papers.authors: Jiaju Wu, Yi Hu, Muhan Zhang
papers.evidence: 循环Transformer反复应用同一组Transformer层
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer通过反复应用同一组Transformer层获得循环式潜在计算能力，但权重共享是否意味着每个循环执行相同运算尚不清楚。作者以图游走任务为测试场景，分析模型原生轨迹中解码预测的前进步数差异，考察共享参数如何被路由到不同操作。研究揭示了循环内部计算的分化机制，为理解循环架构的归纳偏置与长度泛化能力提供依据。其贡献在于细化了权重绑定并不等于计算重复这一关键认识。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers repeatedly apply the same set of Transformer layers, giving them a recurrent architecture for latent computation. Their strong performance on iterative reasoning and length-generalization tasks suggests an appealing explanation: recurrence may provide an inductive bias that lets the model reuse a learned algorithm across loops. However, weight sharing alone does not imply that every loop performs the same operation. This raises a basic question: is each loop actually repeating the same computation, and if not, what routes the shared parameters to different operations?   We study this question using graph walks as a test case. In the model's native trajectories, decoded predictions can advance by different numbers of graph steps or remain at a reached target, showing that recurrent progress need not follow a fixed one-loop-one-step pattern. We then show that a frozen loop can be steered toward different transitions by modifying its entering hidden state: a learned linear layer $J$ selects the desired transition without changing the shared Transformer layers.   To test how this steering works, we use activation patching and find that attention patterns can recover its effects and switch the selected transition. Across five matched pairs of graph models, changing intermediate supervision during backbone training changes which transitions $J$ can induce. This suggests that $J$ selects computations learned by the backbone rather than creating new algorithms. Together, these results show that the hidden state can control shared computation, with attention routing as a causal pathway.

papers.title_en: Closing the Loop: Practical Training Recipes for Looped Language Models
papers.authors: Andrei Marchenko, Viacheslav Bezrukov, Oleg Kashurin, Inessa Fedorova, Dmitry Bocharov, Yuliana Shakhvalieva, Maria Tikhonova, Valerii Ternovskii
papers.evidence: 面向共享层块循环语言模型的实用训练配方
papers.tldr: 循环语言模型通过重复应用共享层块提升有效深度，但已有大规模训练方案需在数万亿 token 上多阶段训练，且循环收益难以与数据和训练差异区分。本文建立实用的循环语言模型训练配方，提出计算高效的从零训练流程，将预算从 7.7T token 降至 310B token 并保持强推理性能。其关键在于预训练加高质量中期训练、学习率预热与更强的退出门正则，从而实现无需多阶段调度的稳定循环训练。
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block of layers, but existing large-scale recipes require multi-stage training over trillions of tokens, while the benefits of recurrence remain difficult to separate from differences in data and training. In this work, we establish practical training recipes for looped language models, with three main results. (1) We develop a compute-efficient from-scratch pipeline that reduces the training budget from 7.7T tokens in Ouro to 310B tokens while retaining strong reasoning performance. Pretraining followed by high-quality mid-training, together with learning-rate warmup and stronger exit-gate regularization, enables stable recurrent training without prior multi-stage schedules. (2) Under controlled comparisons, our 1.4B LoopLM outperforms a parameter-matched dense model trained on the same data and token budget on all 12 evaluated benchmarks, including +14 points on GSM8K, +10 on MATH, and +22 on DROP. At matched inference compute, it approaches a 3.9B dense model on mathematical reasoning and reading comprehension while using only 36\% as many parameters. (3) We introduce a minimal recipe for converting pretrained dense models into looped ones: a single learned input-mixing scalar and a smoothed exit loss, with no step-specific parameters. Applied to Qwen3-1.7B-Base, Looped Qwen improves over an identically continued dense baseline on every evaluated benchmark across two data regimes, with statistically clear gains on GSM8K, MATH, and MMLU-Pro on the curated mixture. Together, these results make looped language models substantially cheaper to train from scratch and practical to introduce into existing pretrained checkpoints, while isolating the gains due to recurrence itself.

papers.title_en: Deeper Backpropagation or More Updates? Training Looped Language Models Across Budgets
papers.authors: Jiarun Shen, Xiao Li
papers.evidence: 训练循环语言模型并重复使用 Transformer 层
papers.tldr: 该文关注循环语言模型训练中反向传播窗口的选择问题：重复 Transformer 层能提升性能但不增加参数，却会增加前后向计算成本。作者在不同训练预算下比较不同反向窗口，分析长窗口的每词元学习效率与短窗口的每次更新成本之间的权衡。研究旨在回答预算变化时应如何选择窗口，为循环大语言模型的高效训练提供指导。
papers.abstract_en: Repeating transformer layers can improve language model performance without adding parameters. However, the added computational depth increases both forward and backward computation costs during training. Training such models requires choosing a backward window that controls how many final layer repetitions retain gradients during backpropagation. Longer windows improve per-token learning efficiency but increase per-update cost, while shorter windows reduce per-update cost but sacrifice per-token efficiency. Understanding which window performs better requires examining different training budgets. Prior work compares backward windows across computational budgets. When training budgets increase, it remains unclear whether the same window continues to perform best. We measure how the relative performance of two windows shifts as training budgets grow. Our method isolates per-token efficiency by training both windows on identical data, and compares complete training recipes at approximately equal training time at each budget. Results show that shorter windows lose much of their advantage as budgets grow. Controlled experiments show that both benefits decrease at larger budgets, with a greater decline in the benefit of extended training. Backward window comparisons depend on the available budget, and the preferred window among the tested candidates can change as the budget grows.

papers.title_en: Dory1.0-4B: A Looped Normalized-GPT
papers.authors: Maxim Fishman, Simeng Sun, Shantanu Acharya, Faisal Ladhak, Brian Chmiel, Santiago Akle Serano, Ron Banner, Boris Ginsburg, Krishna C. Puvvada
papers.evidence: 4B 循环潜变量递归语言模型技术报告，采用共享循环块与弹性深度。
papers.tldr: 该技术报告构建了 40 亿参数的循环潜变量递归语言模型 Dory1.0-4B，采用归一化 Transformer 主干并组织为输入块、共享循环块和输出块。模型支持推理时改变循环块应用次数，从而用单一检查点适配不同计算预算。作者在 6 万亿 token 上预训练，并结合监督微调与可验证奖励强化学习及难度感知循环课程进行后训练。该工作展示了循环层复用在大语言模型训练与弹性推理中的可行性。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Dory1.0-4B, a 4-billion-parameter looped (latent-recurrent) language model with elastic depth: a single checkpoint serves different inference compute budgets. Dory1.0-4B is built on a normalized Transformer (nGPT) backbone with interleaved sliding-window and full-attention layers, organized into an input block, a shared recurrent block, and an output block. At inference, the recurrent block can be applied a variable number of times. We pre-trained Dory1.0-4B on 6 trillion tokens. The first 4.5 trillion tokens were trained in NVFP4, and additional pre-training then extended the context length to 256K tokens. Next, we post-trained the model using Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), with a difficulty-aware loop curriculum that routes harder prompts to deeper loops. Increasing the loop count improves accuracy, with the largest gains on coding, agentic, and long-context benchmarks. With two or more loops, Dory1.0-4B outperforms larger models such as Qwen3.5-9B, Gemma 4 12B, and Gemma 4 26B-A4B on average across 12 benchmarks. Looping also makes Dory1.0-4B more token-efficient on agentic benchmarks: with four loops, it generates 1.3-2.5x fewer tokens than with one loop, as the extra computation is spent in latent space rather than on longer outputs. To reduce memory during looping, Dory1.0-4B caches keys and values only from the last loop, keeping its KV-cache footprint equal to that of a non-looped model at any loop count while retaining most of the accuracy gains. We open-source the BF16, MXFP8, NVFP4, and GGUF quantized checkpoints.

papers.title_en: Reasoning with Latent Thoughts: On the Power of Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Nikunj Saunshi, Nishanth Dikkala, Zhiyuan Li, Sanjiv Kumar, Sashank J. Reddi
papers.evidence: 研究k层结构循环L次的循环Transformer架构
papers.tldr: 缩放定律通常把大模型推理能力归因于参数量与深度。作者提出许多推理问题只需要大深度而非多参数，并系统研究循环Transformer。实验发现k层模型循环L次即可接近kL层非循环模型的表现，显著优于单次k层模型，理论分析也表明这类问题可用迭代算法求解。该结果揭示了以重复计算替代参数扩张的推理新路径。
papers.abstract_en:
Large language models have shown remarkable reasoning abilities and scaling laws suggest that large parameter count, especially along the depth axis, is the primary driver. In this work, we make a stronger claim --- many reasoning problems require a large depth but not necessarily many parameters. This unlocks a novel application of looped models for reasoning. Firstly, we show that for many synthetic reasoning problems like addition, $p$-hop induction, and math problems, a $k$-layer transformer looped $L$ times nearly matches the performance of a $kL$-layer non-looped model, and is significantly better than a $k$-layer model. This is further corroborated by theoretical results showing that many such reasoning problems can be solved via iterative algorithms, and thus, can be solved effectively using looped models with nearly optimal depth. Perhaps surprisingly, these benefits also translate to practical settings of language modeling --- on many downstream reasoning tasks, a language model with $k$-layers looped $L$ times can be competitive to, if not better than, a $kL$-layer language model. In fact, our empirical analysis reveals an intriguing phenomenon: looped and non-looped models exhibit scaling behavior that depends on their effective depth, akin to the inference-time scaling of chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. We further elucidate the connection to CoT reasoning by proving that looped models implicitly generate latent thoughts and can simulate $T$ steps of CoT with $T$ loops. Inspired by these findings, we also present an interesting dichotomy between reasoning and memorization, and design a looping-based regularization that is effective on both fronts.

---

papers.title_en: Loop as a Bridge: Can Looped Transformers Truly Link Representation Space and Natural Language Outputs?
papers.authors: Guanxu Chen, Dongrui Liu, Jing Shao
papers.evidence: 迭代共享层的循环Transformer实证研究
papers.tldr: 大语言模型的内部知识与显式语言输出之间存在鸿沟，本文检验以迭代共享层增加计算深度的循环Transformer能否借迭代特性充当内省来弥合该差距。实验发现增加循环次数确实缩小差距，但部分源于表征所携带内部知识的退化；且循环Transformer对表征的感知只在最后一轮出现，并未随循环提升。结果表明循环迭代并非稳定的内省机制，为理解循环架构的能力边界提供实证依据。
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) often exhibit a gap between their internal knowledge and their explicit linguistic outputs. In this report, we empirically investigate whether Looped Transformers (LTs)--architectures that increase computational depth by iterating shared layers--can bridge this gap by utilizing their iterative nature as a form of introspection. Our experiments reveal that while increasing loop iterations narrows the gap, it is partly driven by a degradation of their internal knowledge carried by representations. Moreover, another empirical analysis suggests that current LTs' ability to perceive representations does not improve across loops; it is only present in the final loop. These results suggest that while LTs offer a promising direction for scaling computational depth, they have yet to achieve the introspection required to truly link representation space and natural language.

papers.title_en: LoopFormer: Elastic-Depth Looped Transformers for Latent Reasoning via Shortcut Modulation
papers.authors: Ahmadreza Jeddi, Marco Ciccone, Babak Taati
papers.evidence: 在变长轨迹上训练循环Transformer以自适应计算深度
papers.tldr: 针对已有循环Transformer在训练与推理中固定迭代次数、难以适应变化算力预算的问题，作者提出LoopFormer，在变长轨迹上训练循环Transformer，并设计捷径一致性训练方案对齐不同深度下的轨迹。实验表明模型可实现预算条件化的推理，按可用算力灵活调节计算深度。该工作把弹性深度引入循环语言模型，为潜在推理提供了更灵活的计算分配方式。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers have emerged as an efficient and powerful class of models for reasoning in the language domain. Recent studies show that these models achieve strong performance on algorithmic and reasoning tasks, suggesting that looped architectures possess an inductive bias toward latent reasoning. However, prior approaches fix the number of loop iterations during training and inference, leaving open the question of whether these models can flexibly adapt their computational depth under variable compute budgets. We introduce LoopFormer, a looped Transformer trained on variable-length trajectories to enable budget-conditioned reasoning. Our core contribution is a shortcut-consistency training scheme that aligns trajectories of different lengths, ensuring that shorter loops yield informative representations while longer loops continue to refine them. LoopFormer conditions each loop on the current time and step size, enabling representations to evolve consistently across trajectories of varying length rather than drifting or stagnating. Empirically, LoopFormer demonstrates robust performance on language modeling and reasoning benchmarks even under aggressive compute constraints, while scaling gracefully with additional budget. These results show that looped Transformers are inherently suited for adaptive language modeling, opening a path toward controllable and budget-aware large language models.

papers.title_en: Adaptive Loops and Memory in Transformers: Think Harder or Know More?
papers.authors: Markus Frey, Behzad Shomali, Ali Hamza Bashir, David Berghaus, Joachim Koehler, Mehdi Ali
papers.evidence: Transformer块以共享权重迭代循环其隐状态
papers.tldr: 针对循环Transformer虽参数高效但存储容量不及逐层独立权重的深层模型的问题，论文研究同时具备自适应逐层循环与门控记忆库的模型。每个Transformer块通过学习到的停机机制迭代其隐状态，记忆库则提供额外可学习存储。实验发现循环主要提升数学推理，记忆库有助于恢复常识任务性能。结果说明循环的效率收益需与外部记忆结合才能兼顾不同类型任务。
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting enables reasoning in language models but requires explicit verbalization of intermediate steps. Looped transformers offer an alternative by iteratively refining representations within hidden states. This parameter efficiency comes at a cost, as looped models lack the storage capacity of deeper models which use unique weights per layer. In this work, we investigate transformer models that feature both adaptive per-layer looping, where each transformer block learns to iterate its hidden state via a learned halting mechanism, and gated memory banks, that provide additional learned storage. We find that looping primarily benefits mathematical reasoning, while memory banks help recover performance on commonsense tasks compared to parameter and FLOP matched models. Combining both mechanisms yields a model that outperforms an iso-FLOP baseline, with three times the number of layers, across math benchmarks. Analysis of model internals reveals layer specialization: early layers learn to loop minimally and access memory sparingly, while later layers do both more heavily.

papers.title_en: Loop, Think, & Generalize: Implicit Reasoning in Recurrent-Depth Transformers
papers.authors: Harsh Kohli, Srinivasan Parthasarathy, Huan Sun, Yuekun Yao
papers.evidence: 循环深度 Transformer 对同一批层进行迭代计算
papers.tldr: Transformer 大模型虽存储大量事实与规则，却常难以在单次前向中组合知识完成隐式多跳推理。作者研究对同一批 Transformer 层迭代计算的循环深度 Transformer，并考察系统性泛化与深度外推两类组合泛化挑战。实验刻画了该架构在未见组合与更深循环下的泛化行为，为通过迭代复用层增强大模型隐式推理能力提供了依据。
papers.abstract_en: We study implicit reasoning, i.e. the ability to combine knowledge or rules within a single forward pass. While transformer-based large language models store substantial factual knowledge and rules, they often fail to compose this knowledge for implicit multi-hop reasoning, suggesting a lack of compositional generalization over their parametric knowledge. To address this limitation, we study recurrent-depth transformers, which enables iterative computation over the same transformer layers. We investigate two compositional generalization challenges under the implicit reasoning scenario: systematic generalization, i.e. combining knowledge that is never used for compositions during training, and depth extrapolation, i.e. generalizing from limited reasoning depth (e.g. training on up to 5-hop) to deeper compositions (e.g. 10-hop). Through controlled studies with models trained from scratch, we show that while vanilla transformers struggle with both generalization challenges, recurrent-depth transformers can effectively make such generalization. For systematic generalization, we find that this ability emerges through a three-stage grokking process, transitioning from memorization to in-distribution generalization and finally to systematic generalization, supported by mechanistic analysis. For depth extrapolation, we show that generalization beyond training depth can be unlocked by scaling inference-time recurrence, with more iterations enabling deeper reasoning. We further study how training strategies affect extrapolation, providing guidance on training recurrent-depth transformers, and identify a key limitation, overthinking, where excessive recurrence degrades predictions and limits generalization to very deep compositions.

papers.title_en: Parcae: Scaling Laws For Stable Looped Language Models
papers.authors: Hayden Prairie, Zachary Novack, Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick, Daniel Y. Fu
papers.evidence: 循环语言模型让激活反复经过同一层块，并给出稳定的缩放定律
papers.tldr: 固定深度模型靠堆参数或数据提升质量，代价是显存与算力开销；循环架构改用共享层块反复计算，却常因残差爆炸与损失尖峰而不稳定。作者把循环重写为残差流上的非线性时变动力系统，用线性近似发现注入参数谱范数过大是失稳根源，并提出稳定训练配方。实验表明循环语言模型可稳定训练并遵循可预测的缩放定律，为参数高效的深度扩展提供了理论与实证依据。
papers.abstract_en: Traditional fixed-depth architectures scale quality by increasing training FLOPs, typically through increased parameterization, at the expense of a higher memory footprint, or data. A potential alternative is looped architectures, which instead increase FLOPs by sending activations through a block of layers in a loop. While promising, existing recipes for training looped architectures can be unstable, suffering from residual explosion and loss spikes. We address these challenges by recasting looping as a nonlinear time-variant dynamical system over the residual stream. Via a linear approximation to this system, we find that instability occurs in existing looped architectures as a result of large spectral norms in their injection parameters. To address these instability issues, we propose Parcae, a novel stable, looped architecture that constrains the spectral norm of the injection parameters via discretization of a negative diagonal parameterization. As a result, Parcae achieves up to 6.3% lower validation perplexity over prior large-scale looped models. Using our stable looped architecture, we investigate the scaling properties of looping as a medium to improve quality by increasing FLOPs in training and test-time. For training, we derive predictable power laws to scale FLOPs while keeping parameter count fixed. Our initial scaling laws suggest that looping and data should be increased in tandem, given a fixed FLOP budget. At test-time, we find that Parcae can use looping to scale compute, following a predictable, saturating exponential decay. When scaled up to 1.3B parameters, we find that Parcae improves CORE and Core-Extended quality by 2.99 and 1.18 points when compared to strong Transformer baselines under a fixed parameter and data budget, achieving a relative quality of up to 87.5% a Transformer twice the size.

papers.title_en: How Much Is One Recurrence Worth? Iso-Depth Scaling Laws for Looped Language Models
papers.authors: Kristian Schwethelm, Daniel Rueckert, Georgios Kaissis
papers.evidence: 用等深度缩放律量化深度循环语言模型中一次循环的等价价值
papers.tldr: 循环（深度循环）Transformer通过重复共享块提升参数效率，但一次循环究竟等价于多少独立参数缺乏定量答案。作者在循环次数1、2、4、8、约50倍训练算力范围内开展等深度预训练扫描，拟合包含循环项的联合缩放律并估计循环等价指数。结果显示该指数约为0.46，介于完全等价与无容量增益之间，说明用共享循环替换独立块确有收益但小于等量独立层。该结论为循环深度设计提供定量依据。
papers.abstract_en: We measure how much one recurrence is worth to a looped (depth-recurrent) transformer, in equivalent unique parameters. From an iso-depth pretraining sweep across recurrence counts $r \in \{1, 2, 4, 8\}$ spanning ${\sim}50\times$ in training compute, we fit a joint scaling law $L = E + A\,(N_\text{once} + r^{\varphi} N_\text{rec})^{-α} + B\,D^{-β}$ and measure a recurrence-equivalence exponent $\varphi = 0.46$. Intuitively, $\varphi$ tells us whether looping a block $r$ times is equivalent in validation loss to $r$ unique blocks of a non-looped model (full equivalence, $\varphi{=}1$) or to a single block run repeatedly with no capacity gain ($\varphi{=}0$). Our $\varphi = 0.46$ sits in between, so replacing unique blocks with shared recurrences increases validation loss at matched training compute. For example, at $r{=}4$ a 410M looped model performs on par with a 580M non-looped model, but incurs the training cost of a 1B non-looped one. We demonstrate the utility of $\varphi$ as a diagnostic tool on two case studies: commonly used truncated backpropagation lowers $\varphi$ to $0.38$, indicating that the loop mechanism is poorly trained under truncation, even though validation loss decreases. Conversely, hyperconnections raise $\varphi$ to $0.65$, a genuine capacity gain. Our method separates true loop improvements from training-side gains, a distinction raw validation loss cannot make.

papers.title_en: Hyperloop Transformers
papers.authors: Abbas Zeitoun, Lucas Torroba-Hennigen, Yoon Kim
papers.evidence: 以大语言模型为核心的循环 Transformer 跨深度层复用
papers.tldr: 边缘与端侧部署对模型内存占用敏感，因此需要在大语言模型中兼顾质量与参数效率。作者以循环 Transformer 为核心原语，将其组织为 begin、middle 与 end 三个块，每个块由多层 Transformer 组成，仅中间块在深度上循环复用。该设计在同等深度下显著减少参数量并提升参数效率，同时保持语言建模质量。工作为内存受限场景提供了简洁有效的循环层复用大语言模型架构。
papers.abstract_en: LLM architecture research generally aims to maximize model quality subject to fixed compute/latency budgets. However, many applications of interest such as edge and on-device deployment are further constrained by the model's memory footprint, thus motivating parameter-efficient architectures for language modeling. This paper describes a simple architecture that improves the parameter-efficiency of LLMs. Our architecture makes use of looped Transformers as a core primitive, which reuse Transformer layers across depth and are thus more parameter-efficient than ordinary (depth-matched) Transformers. We organize the looped Transformer into three blocks--begin, middle, and end blocks--where each block itself consists of multiple Transformer layers, and only the middle block is applied recurrently across depth. We augment the looped middle block with hyper-connections (Xie et al., 2026), which expand the residual stream into matrix-valued residual streams. Hyper-connections are applied only after each loop, and therefore add minimal new parameters and compute cost. Across various model scales, we find that our Hyper-Connected Looped Transformer (Hyperloop Transformer) is able to perform well compared to depth-matched Transformer and mHC Transformer baselines despite using approximately 50% fewer parameters. This performance persists through post-training weight quantization, thus positioning Hyperloop Transformers as an attractive architecture for memory-efficient language modeling.

papers.title_en: Sparse Layers are Critical to Scaling Looped Language Models
papers.authors: Ryan Lee, Jacob Biloki, Edward J. Hu, Jonathan May
papers.evidence: 研究通过深度重复同一组Transformer层的循环语言模型
papers.tldr: 循环语言模型通过重复使用同一组Transformer层降低内存开销，但相比使用独立层的标准Transformer扩展性更差。作者系统对比了稠密与专家混合Transformer在有无循环下的表现，发现循环MoE模型扩展性优于标准基线，而稠密循环模型则不然，原因是不同循环轮次会激活不同专家从而恢复表达力。研究还发现循环模型配合早退出具有更好的计算-质量权衡，指出稀疏性是循环语言模型扩展的关键。
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models repeat a set of transformer layers through depth, reducing memory costs and providing natural early-exit points at loop boundaries. However, looped models do not scale as favorably as standard transformers with unique layers. We compare standard and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformers, with and without looping, and find two main results. First, we find Looped-MoE models scale better than the standard baseline while dense looped models do not. We trace this to routing divergence between loops: in Looped-MoE models, different experts are activated on each pass through the same shared layers, recovering expressivity without additional parameters. Our second finding is that looped models have better compute-quality trade-offs with early exits than standard models. Because each loop ends with the same layers that produce the final output, loop boundaries are superior exit points, as confirmed by earlier output convergence at these points. In sum, we provide a clear direction for scaling looped models: a Looped-MoE model with early exits can not only beat standard transformers at scale, but also enable significant memory and inference savings with minimal degradation in quality.

papers.title_en: LT2: Linear-Time Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Chunyuan Deng, Yizhe Zhang, Rui-Jie Zhu, Yuanyuan Xu, Jiarui Liu, T. S. Eugene Ng, Hanjie Chen
papers.evidence: 循环 Transformer 多次迭代层，LT2 用线性或稀疏注意力替代 softmax 注意力。
papers.tldr: 该文针对循环 Transformer 反复迭代层时仍使用全注意力、计算复杂度高的问题，提出 LT2 线性时间循环架构。作者分别研究线性注意力与稀疏注意力两个变体，并从理论上说明循环能与迭代记忆细化和感受野扩展产生协同。实验验证了这些变体在保持循环架构优势的同时提升效率。该工作为可扩展的循环 Transformer 语言模型提供了高效注意力方案。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers (LT) have emerged as a powerful architecture by iterating their layers multiple times before decoding the final token. However, pairing them with full attention retains quadratic complexity, making them computationally expensive and slow. We introduce LT2 (Linear-Time Looped Transformers), a family of looped architectures that replace quadratic softmax attention with subquadratic, linear-time attention. We study two variants: LT2-linear with linear attention and LT2-sparse with sparse attention. We find that looping uniquely synergizes with these variants: it enables iterative memory refinement in linear attention and progressively expands the effective receptive field in sparse attention. We formalize these benefits theoretically and demonstrate consistent empirical gains across controlled recall, state-tracking, and language modeling tasks. We then explore LT2-hybrid, which combines different attention variants in a looped setting. Two variants are especially promising: LT2-hybrid (GDN+DSA), which interleaves linear and sparse attention to maximize efficiency and matches the standard looped transformer's quality at fully linear-time cost; and LT2-hybrid (Full+GDN), which interleaves GDN with a small fraction of full attention layers to maximize quality, surpassing the standard looped transformer in both performance and efficiency. We also show how to convert a pre-trained LT into an LT2-hybrid model. With about 1B tokens of training, our converted model, Ouro-hybrid-1.4B, outperforms industry-level 1B models and is competitive with industry-level 4B models while retaining the speed benefits of linear-time attention. Together, these results show a clear path toward making looped transformers more scalable and advancing efficient, capable small language models.

papers.title_en: LoopMoE: Unifying Iterative Computation with Mixture-of-Experts for Language Modeling
papers.authors: Wenkai Chen, Tianshu Li, Wenyong Huang, Yichun Yin, Lifeng Shang, Chengwei Qin
papers.evidence: 结合迭代权重共享计算的循环MoE语言模型
papers.tldr: 循环架构可扩展有效深度，但主流实现依赖稠密骨干，使参数与每token FLOPs耦合，难以在匹配预算下分离迭代计算的作用。作者提出LoopMoE，将稀疏路由与迭代权重共享计算结合，并用IterAdaLN以迭代索引与隐藏状态调制破解权重共享对称性，另设容量均衡策略。该工作为循环语言模型提供了可隔离迭代计算效应的实验平台。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and looped architectures scale models along two orthogonal axes, namely parameter capacity and effective depth. However, mainstream looped architectures rely on dense backbones that couple parameter count with per-token FLOPs, which makes it impossible to isolate the effect of iterative computation under matched budgets. To this end, we present LoopMoE, a looped MoE language model that integrates sparse routing with iterative weight-shared computation through two designs. The first is IterAdaLN, which resolves weight-sharing symmetry via a modulation signal jointly conditioned on the iteration index and the per-token hidden state. The second is a capacity-balancing strategy that recovers the attention-to-FFN active parameter ratio of well-tuned non-looped references. Together, these designs enable the first strictly controlled, head-to-head evaluation of a looped MoE against a Vanilla MoE under identical total parameters, per-token FLOPs, and active sublayer ratios. Across nine downstream benchmarks, LoopMoE's average improvement over its matched vanilla MoE increases from over 1 point at the 3B scale to approximately 3 points at the 9B scale. These results provide initial evidence that the benefits of iterative sparse computation may strengthen with scale, positioning LoopMoE as a promising architecture for scalable looped language models.

papers.title_en: On the Residual Scaling of Looped Transformers: Stability and Transferability
papers.authors: Shaowen Wang, Bingrui Li, Ge Zhang, Wenhao Huang, Shen Yan, Jian Li
papers.evidence: 权重共享循环 Transformer 与跨迭代残差缩放
papers.tldr: 循环（权重共享）Transformer 重复应用同一残差块，以在不增加参数的情况下提升有效深度，但原有残差网络的 1/√L 缩放准则在权重共享下不再充分。论文指出迭代之间的更新相关需要更强的 1/N 缩放，并为多层块推导出分离层内循环相关与层间方差的 λ/(N√L) 分解参数化。理论分析与实验表明该准则能稳定循环模型训练并改善可迁移性，为循环语言模型架构提供了有依据的深度缩放准则。
papers.abstract_en: Looped (weight-tied) Transformers apply a shared residual block $N$ times ($h \leftarrow h + \varepsilon\,f(h)$, same $f$ at each step), increasing effective depth without adding parameters. Prior depth-scaling analyses prescribe $\varepsilon = 1/\!\sqrt{L}$ for depth-$L$ residual networks. We show that this is insufficient for looped architectures: weight sharing makes residual updates correlated across iterations, requiring the stronger scaling $\varepsilon = 1/N$. For multi-layer blocks ($L$ unique layers looped $N$ times), we derive a factored parameterization $\varepsilon = λ/(N\!\sqrt{L})$ that separates the two sources of growth: $1/N$ controls the within-layer loop correlation, and $1/\!\sqrt{L}$ controls the across-layer variance. A key consequence is that the optimal learning rate depends only on the number of unique layers $L$, not on the loop count $N$, enabling direct hyperparameter transfer from small to large $N$ without retuning. Experiments on looped Transformers confirm that $1/N$ scaling improves trainability and yields better loss than $1/\!\sqrt{N}$ scaling across loop counts.

papers.title_en: Dense Supervision Is Not Enough: The Readout Blind Spot in Looped Language Models
papers.authors: Rituraj Sharma, Tu Vu
papers.evidence: 分析循环语言模型中隐藏状态反馈到递归计算时的监督问题。
papers.tldr: 该文关注循环语言模型将隐藏状态作为运行时状态反复反馈时的监督有效性问题，追问交叉熵究竟控制哪些状态变量。作者指出逐循环密集损失只控制读出层暴露的变量，而尺度不变读出会隐藏径向尺度，使循环尺度未被约束。在 4400 万和 1.29 亿参数循环 Transformer 上的分析揭示了这一读出盲区。研究为循环语言模型的训练监督设计提供了重要警示。
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models turn hidden states into runtime state: each state is decoded for prediction and fed back into future computation. This creates a basic supervision question: which state variables does cross-entropy actually control? We show that dense per-loop cross-entropy controls the variables exposed by the readout, not every variable active in the recurrent transition. Hidden-state scale gives a concrete failure mode. Scale-invariant readouts such as RMSNorm and LayerNorm hide radial scale from the immediate cross-entropy loss, while pre-norm residual recurrence continues to carry and update that same scale. Thus per-loop loss can make early exits usable without controlling recurrent scale. In 44M and 129M looped transformers without inter-loop normalization, per-loop cross-entropy through RMSNorm readouts still drives final hidden-state norms into the thousands or tens of thousands. Scale-visible readouts and explicit norm penalties keep norms in the tens, and scale-removing recurrence is the complementary architectural fix. The resulting design rule is simple: dense supervision trains exits; recurrent scale control requires either making scale visible to a loss or removing it from the loop. Consistent with this rule, scale-controlled variants achieve lower perplexity at matched inference-depth operating points in our variable-depth benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Bridging the Gap Between Latent and Explicit Reasoning with Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Ying Fan, Anej Svete, Kangwook Lee
papers.evidence: 循环递归深度Transformer复用权重加深计算而不增加参数
papers.tldr: 针对现有潜在思维链方法在超过十亿参数后明显落后于显式思维链、且差距随规模扩大的问题，作者研究复用权重以加深计算而不增加参数的循环递归深度Transformer，并提出一种循环填充Transformer配方，并行处理K个潜在块。实验表明该简单配方能够弥合潜在推理与显式推理之间的差距。该工作说明循环深度架构是承载潜在推理、提升大模型推理效率的有效载体。
papers.abstract_en: Language models typically reason via explicit chain-of-thought (CoT), generating intermediate steps token-by-token. Latent CoT offers an alternative: it performs multi-step reasoning in the model's hidden states, replacing decoded tokens with continuous representations for greater efficiency. However, existing latent CoT methods underperform explicit CoT beyond 1B parameters, and the gap widens with scale. Looped, or recurrent-depth, Transformers, which reuse their weights to increase computation depth without adding parameters, are a natural fit for latent reasoning. We therefore ask whether looped Transformers can bridge this gap. We answer affirmatively with a simple recipe: a looped padded Transformer that processes K latent blocks in parallel for R iterations, with a cross-entropy loss on each latent position's gold CoT-step token, similar to explicit CoT supervision. We instantiate it as LOTUS (Looped Transformers with parallel supervision on latents). LOTUS is, to our knowledge, the first latent-CoT method to bridge the gap to explicit CoT at the 3B scale, while cutting thought-phase latency by 2.5x-6.9x from compact math expressions to natural language. Projecting LOTUS's post-loop latents through the base LM head recovers the gold reasoning steps and even surfaces alternative valid intermediate steps, evidence that its latent space is interpretable and CoT-aligned. Ablations confirm that both the looped backbone and the parallel supervision on gold CoT tokens are essential. Code is available at https://github.com/yingfan-bot/lotus.

papers.title_en: DeepLoop: Depth Scaling for Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Shuzhen Li, Yifan Zhang, Jiacheng Guo, Quanquan Gu, Mengdi Wang
papers.evidence: 循环 Transformer 多轮复用紧凑模块并共享参数，分析绑定深度下的残差缩放。
papers.tldr: 该文关注循环 Transformer 在复用同一组物理块多轮计算时的深度扩展问题，指出共享参数会让重复访问的梯度聚合，从而改变残差缩放规律。作者通过一阶扰动界和访问对齐系数刻画这种绑定深度效应，并推导出与 DeepNorm 不同的缩放指数要求。分析表明对齐程度会影响循环模型的稳定训练与深度收益。该工作为循环 Transformer 的深度缩放和参数共享训练提供了理论依据。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers scale sequential computation by applying a compact stack of physical blocks for multiple rounds, increasing unrolled depth without increasing stored parameters. This reuse changes the residual-scaling problem: in an untied Transformer, each residual branch receives and applies its own parameter update, whereas in a looped Transformer one shared update aggregates gradients from repeated visits and is read back by those same visits in the next linearized forward pass. We formalize this tied-depth effect through a first-order perturbation bound controlled by a visit-alignment coefficient $κ_R$. The bound recovers the DeepNorm exponent when visits decorrelate, but in the conservative aligned regime it requires the exponent to increase from $1/4$ to $1/2$ as loop count grows at fixed physical depth. The resulting method, \textbf{DeepLoop}, keeps the Post-LN DeepNorm architecture and sets $α=(2N)^{1/2}$ and $β=(8N)^{-1/2}$ for unrolled depth $N$. On GPT-style looped language models at GPT-2 small and GPT-2 medium scale, DeepLoop is neutral when no physical block is revisited and improves validation loss and downstream accuracy once recurrent depth is activated. These results show that stable recurrent depth requires residual scaling rules that account for parameter visits, not only nominal layer count.

papers.title_en: Looped Transformers with Source-Centered State Evolution
papers.authors: Bum Jun Kim, Kohei Hayashi, Shunsuke Kamiya, Masanori Koyama, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo
papers.evidence: 循环Transformer在循环深度上复用同一块并保持共享循环
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer复用同一Transformer块以固定参数增加有效深度，但该共享块需在训练与推断深度上掌控整条隐状态轨迹，且每步重新注入的输入条件信号会推动状态漂移。作者提出源中心状态演化方法，通过学习锚点保留输入依赖，同时维持参考保持的共享循环。该机制调和了输入条件与稳定循环之间的矛盾，改善了深度外推下的状态演化。工作为循环大模型的循环状态设计提供了更稳健的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers create a useful train- and test-time compute axis by reusing the same Transformer block over recurrent depth, increasing effective depth at a fixed parameter count. However, that shared block must then govern an entire trajectory of varying hidden states over trained and extrapolated depths. Furthermore, in additive-injection looped Transformers, an input-conditioned signal is reintroduced at every recurrent step, so applying the shared transition at an input-conditioned reference can still move the hidden state. In this paper, we propose Source-Centered State Evolution (SCSE), which is designed to reconcile input conditioning with reference-preserving shared recurrence. Specifically, SCSE retains input dependence through its learned anchor and initial deviation, allows nonzero deviations to drive recurrent computation while mapping zero deviation to zero, and guarantees exact anchor invariance through its zero-deviation mask. The designated anchor is thereby a one-step fixed point by construction. The zero-deviation forcing bias is the next deviation produced from the anchor itself and vanishes in SCSE, while nonzero deviations remain active and support state-dependent recurrent computation. Our theory shows that the zero-deviation forcing bias is a design degree of freedom whose task effect can be harmful, neutral, or beneficial; SCSE resolves this choice in favor of exact anchor invariance by setting the bias to zero. Across WikiText-2, WikiText-103, direct web-corpus pretraining, held-out web-text transfer, and LAMBADA completion, SCSE improves the controlled recurrent quality frontier. Ablation studies identify the learned anchor and the anchor-coordinate deviation recurrence as the primary contributors to the gain, and a trained-model case study grounds the anchor-response diagnostic in observed recurrent motion.

papers.title_en: LoopMTP: A looped transformer guided by latent multi-token prediction
papers.authors: Behzad Shomali, Markus Frey, David Berghaus, Joachim Koehler, Mehdi Ali
papers.evidence: 循环Transformer在T次迭代中复用同一层堆栈，并由潜在多词预测引导
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer通过复用同一层堆栈多次迭代，以固定参数量获得更大有效深度，但中间表示缺乏跨循环指导，导致潜在过度思考与计算同质化。作者提出LoopMTP，利用循环T次可预测T个未来词的结构对应关系，把多词预测的稠密监督软对齐到各循环的隐状态。该引导使循环计算更具区分性，提升了参数高效模型的有效深度与推理表现。
papers.abstract_en: Looped transformers have emerged as a parameter-efficient alternative to scaling depth for strong reasoning. By reusing one stack of layers across $T$ iterations, they attain the effective depth and reasoning capabilities of larger models at a fixed parameter count. Yet existing approaches suffer from latent overthinking and undifferentiated computation, largely because intermediate representations receive no guidance across loops. Multi-token prediction (MTP) supplies exactly the dense, forward-looking supervision the loop is missing. We propose \textsc{LoopMTP}, which links the two through a structural correspondence in latent space: a model that loops $T$ times can anticipate $T$ future tokens. \textsc{LoopMTP} realizes this by softly aligning the hidden state of loop $t$ with the embedding of the token $t$ steps ahead, while a lightweight gate preserves useful information across iterations. \textsc{LoopMTP} improves average accuracy by up to 8.1\% (relative) over the non-looped baseline, with training remaining stable for up to 15 loops.

papers.title_en: Retrofitting Recurrent Depth into a Pretrained Language Model: Installation, Extrapolation, Transfer, and Retention at Two Parameter Budgets
papers.authors: Mark Shapiro
papers.evidence: 为预训练大模型加装权重共享循环块
papers.tldr: 稠密预训练语言模型能否改造为具有循环深度的模型尚不明确。作者将Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct拆分为前奏、权重共享循环块与尾声，并加入保持恒等的一轮路径与再入桥接，在两种参数预算下进行改造训练。结果显示一轮时性能不逊于基座，循环机制是可复用的过程而非答案查表，配合中间步监督可每轮计算一个任务步骤，并具备外推、迁移与保持能力。该工作为在现有大模型上引入循环层复用提供了可行路径。
papers.abstract_en: A dense, pretrained language model can be retrofitted with recurrent depth and learn an iterative latent transition that persists after outcome-only annealing. Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct is split into a Prelude, a weight-tied Recurrent Block, and a Coda, with an identity-preserving one-loop path and a re-entry bridge on later loops. At loop 1 the retrofit remains non-inferior to its base on a preregistered ARC battery. Three findings. First, the mechanism is a reusable procedure rather than terminal-answer lookup, and installs at two budgets: 6M trained parameters over frozen base weights and 180M full-block. With intermediate-step supervision, the model computes one task step per loop and persists when only final answers are graded. The adapter matched the full block overall (83.8% versus 84.0%), led through depth 11, and trailed beyond. Verbal fine-tuning reached 79-86% on controlled verbal renderings (zero-shot transfer was minimal), and adapter verbal training begun from the installed mechanism outpaced matched fresh training by 18.6 points, including on a held-out test set. Second, the operation extrapolates to roughly 1.5 times its supervised depth, holding 70% accuracy through depth 18. Third, a same-size scratchpad-trained model matched the recurrent model within its learned horizon but collapsed beyond it. The recurrent model won overall, 84% versus 72%, retained 53% versus 2.5% beyond depth 10, and answered 7.6 times faster. An iterative transformer can therefore perform deeper reasoning in latent space faster than comparable or larger models fine-tuned on the same task, in a system-level comparison. A second task, running the rule in reverse, exposed the limits: the inverse was learnable in isolation, but no continuation acquired it while preserving the installed mechanism and general capability, a catastrophic-interference boundary. Learned depth selection remains open.

papers.title_en: Allocating Recurrent Compute in Looped Language Models
papers.authors: Ruhai Lin, Yiyang Guo, Rui-Jie Zhu, Hao Ye, Jason K. Eshraghian
papers.evidence: 循环语言模型反复施加共享计算，并探讨哪一部分应当循环
papers.tldr: 循环语言模型通过反复施加共享计算提升推理与知识操作能力，但现有系统通常整体重复整个层堆栈，忽视了混合器与前馈网络在操作和成本上的差异。作者以状态更新的重复复合视角提出迭代传输秩指标，刻画各次施加带来的非冗余影响，并据此设计MixerLoop，仅重复Gated DeltaNet混合器。该工作为循环语言模型中循环对象的选择提供了理论依据与更优的计算分配方案。
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models improve reasoning and knowledge manipulation by applying shared computation repeatedly. Existing systems usually repeat an entire layer stack, although a mixer and a dense feed-forward network (FFN) perform different operations and have different costs. We ask a narrower question: what should loop? We view recurrence as repeated composition of a state update and argue that an application is valuable when it exposes a new cross-position influence direction that remains observable at the task readout. Iterative Transport Rank (ITR) describes the cumulative influence trajectory; marginal ITR describes the nonredundant influence contributed by successive applications. This view motivates MixerLoop, which repeats each Gated DeltaNet mixer while applying its dense FFN once. We compare MixerLoop with no recurrence and full-block recurrence at 15M and 110M parameters under the same data, initialization, and architecture. A finite context-off intervention tests whether later mixer applications produce distinct, non-negligible, and beneficial changes at the final language-model readout. MixerLoop surpasses FullLoop on aggregate CORE at 15M and retains 41.5% of its CORE improvement at 110M while reducing recurrent-backbone projection FLOPs by 45.9%. These results show that the benefits of recurrent depth can be retained without repeatedly executing the dense FFN.

papers.title_en: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Shaowen Wang, Ge Zhang, Kairong Luo, Yuhao Wu, Shaofan Liu, Jiaheng Liu, Wenhao Huang, Shen Yan, Jian Li
papers.evidence: 研究共享循环层的MoE循环Transformer缩放规律
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer以迭代共享层块提升有效深度，但既有评估多在固定模型规模下比较，难以区分架构收益与额外算力。作者在MoE Transformer上严格匹配每token FLOPs、非嵌入参数与KV缓存，经消融提出中间一半层循环两次的SMELT配方。该模型扩展至540亿非嵌入参数并拟合Chinchilla式缩放律，损失随算力下降更快，节省6.8%至18.0%训练FLOPs。这为计算量匹配条件下循环架构的价值提供了系统性证据。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by iterating a shared block of layers, but most evaluations compare at fixed model size, conflating architectural advantage with extra FLOPs. We study looping on Mixture-of-Experts Transformers while closely matching per-token FLOPs, total non-embedding parameters, and KV cache. Through a series of ablations, we arrive at a recipe we call SMELT (Sparse MoE Transformer, middle layers Loop Twice), which loops the middle half of layers twice while matching the unlooped Baseline on all three budgets. We scale SMELT across four sizes up to 54B non-embedding parameters and fit a separate Chinchilla-style scaling law for each architecture. SMELT's loss drops faster with compute, saving 6.8--18.0\% of training FLOPs on the compute-optimal frontier. The advantage transfers to downstream benchmarks beyond what validation loss predicts, is largest on Code, and grows with sample length and the number of in-context examples. Mechanistic analysis shows that the second visit reduces the attention sink and redirects mass toward content-relevant tokens, an inductive bias that may underlie the observed performance gains. These results show that looping can improve Transformers even under budget matching, offering a practical recipe that turns depth reuse into measurable gains.

papers.title_en: T-LoopFormer: Token-Level Elastic-Depth Looped Transformers for Latent Reasoning With Dynamic Routing
papers.authors: Mingqian Yu, Wenpeng Zhang, Peilin Zhao
papers.evidence: 循环Transformer在多次迭代中复用共享参数以处理语言与推理任务
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer通过复用共享参数在多次迭代中提升推理与语言任务表现，但现有方法对所有Token施加固定递归深度，导致算力分配次优、效率提升空间未被充分利用。本文提出Token级动态选择路由机制，使每个Token可自适应决定循环深度，从而在潜在空间推理中更精细地分配计算。该工作为循环Transformer的参数高效推理提供了弹性深度控制的新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers have recently demonstrated strong performance in both reasoning and language tasks by reusing a shared set of parameters across multiple iterations, achieving parameter efficiency without sacrificing representational power. Besides, looped Transformers perform inference directly in the latent space (latent reasoning) to reduce the number of tokens consumed during inference, thereby achieving improved sample efficiency. However, these models typically apply a fixed recursion depth uniformly to every token, leading to suboptimal compute allocation and leaving significant efficiency gains on the table. In this work, we propose \textbf{dynamic token-choice routing} for looped transformers, enabling each token to adaptively determine its own number of loop iterations based on its hidden state. We use a dynamic router to decide whether a token should continue recursing or exit early, allowing simple tokens to bypass unnecessary computation while hard tokens receive deeper processing. To ensure that this adaptive mechanism does not compromise decoding efficiency, we further introduce recursion-wise KV caching, which maintains an independent key-value cache for each recursion loop. This design ensures that tokens at different depths only attend to their corresponding cached states, effectively eliminating redundant computations for exited tokens and enabling fast autoregressive decoding. Extensive experiments show that T-LoopFormer reaches the sota performance under the same parameters on PPL and 10 zero-shot reasoning tasks, even surpassing the base model at 24x FLOPs and our model could reach the lowest inference latency, which validate the effectiveness of token-choice router and recursion-wise KV cache. Code: https://github.com/YuMingQian1234/T-LoopFormer.

papers.title_en: The Surprising Effectiveness of Shared Memory in Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Giovanni Monea, Keshav Ramji, Yousef El-Kurdi, Luis A. Lastras, Yoav Artzi, Nathan Godey, Ramón Fernandez Astudillo
papers.evidence: 预训练多次应用相同层的循环语言模型
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer对每个token多次应用相同层，以增加计算提升质量而不增加参数，但每次循环都写入独立KV缓存使显存随计算增长。作者预训练循环语言模型共享记忆：仅首次循环写缓存，后续循环读取并保留短窗口。在1.5亿至10亿参数规模上，共享记忆不仅未损质量反而提升，混合变体在五次循环下刷新质量-显存前沿。该结果说明循环层复用可与记忆共享有效结合。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers apply the same layers several times per token, adding compute to improve quality without more parameters. Each recursion, however, writes its own key-value cache, so memory still grows with compute. Inference-time techniques can shrink this cache at a cost in quality. We pretrain looped language models to share memory: only the first recursion writes a cache, and later recursions read it while keeping a short window of their own. Surprisingly, we find that sharing memory does not cost quality and instead improves it. At 150M-1B parameters, our Looped Prediction Transformer (LPT) and its hybrid variant set a new quality-memory frontier for looped models: with five recursions, the hybrid lowers validation perplexity on FineWeb-Edu by 1.12-1.82 relative to a same-size standard Transformer while using 76-79% less context memory. Through an extensive analysis, we investigate why memory sharing helps. Shared and local memory develop different representations, and later recursions attend mostly to the shared memory, which also acts as a gradient highway to the first recursion.

papers.title_en: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part I: Topology, Input Injection, Recurrent-State Design
papers.authors: Benhao Huang, Chufan Shi, Junlin Chen, Shicheng Wen, Zhengzhong Liu, Eric Xing, Xuezhe Ma
papers.evidence: 循环语言模型跨逻辑深度复用物理Transformer块
papers.tldr: 循环语言模型跨逻辑深度复用物理Transformer块，但现有架构把循环位置、输入注入与循环状态组织纠缠在一起。作者在参数规模、逻辑深度与token预算匹配条件下从零训练模型，逐一分离上述设计轴，并检验原则能否迁移到MoE模型。结果显示前奏-循环块-尾声的三明治结构在上下文抽取与推理密集任务上稳定提升，输入注入主要增强知识检索。该工作为构建更优循环语言模型提供了可复用设计原则。
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models reuse physical Transformer blocks across logical depth, but established architectures entangle recurrence placement, input injection, and recurrent state organization. We isolate these axes in models trained from scratch at matched parameter scale, logical depth, and token budgets, and then test whether the resulting design principles transfer to resident- and active-parameter-matched Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The prelude-recurrent block-coda sandwich architecture consistently improves performance on context extraction and reasoning-intensive tasks. Input injection primarily enhances knowledge retrieval and context utilization, whereas random initialization and separate H/L recurrent states provide mixed or negative returns. Taken together, these results favor the Huginn-style design: at the 730M-parameter and 336B-token scale, the complete Huginn architecture outperforms Ouro across all ten benchmarks. The advantages of Huginn over Ouro transfer to MoE models. At the 8BA0.8B (32BA3B when unrolled) scale trained on 500B tokens, Huginn outperforms Ouro on nearly all benchmarks spanning knowledge, reasoning, and coding, while also exhibiting more balanced expert routing. Under matched training and inference FLOPs, the Huginn-style model uses 75% fewer resident parameters than a 112-layer feedforward MoE baseline. Despite its smaller physical parameters, it outperforms the feedforward baseline on DROP and GSM8K, matches it on MATH500, and remains competitive on the other benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation
papers.authors: Xuyuan Xiong, Siyu Chen, Zihan Shao, Yue Su, Weiyang Jin, Ping Luo, Zhuoran Yang, Xihui Liu
papers.evidence: 循环Transformer复用共享层块并采用时间反向传播训练
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer复用共享层块以在不增加参数的情况下提升计算深度，并通过时间反向传播训练，为节省算力常将BPTT截断到最后几次循环。作者系统研究截断的价值，联合变化模型规模、训练Token数与前后向循环次数，完成近600次训练并拟合统一缩放律。结果表明截断虽节省训练算力却带来有偏梯度，拟合出的缩放律更支持保留足够的循环步数。
papers.abstract_en: Looped transformers reuse a shared block of layers to increase computational depth without increasing the number of trainable parameters. They are trained with backpropagation through time (BPTT). To save training compute, BPTT is often truncated to the last few loops, but truncation yields biased gradients that may weaken the benefit of looping. In this work, we study the value of truncation in looped transformer training in a systematic way: we jointly vary model size, training tokens, and forward and backward loop counts across nearly 600 training runs and fit a unified scaling law that captures the effects of looping and truncation through effective parameters. Despite the training-compute savings of truncation, our fitted law favors full BPTT when forward and backward loop counts are jointly optimized. In matched-compute runs, full BPTT through fewer loops consistently outperforms truncated settings of the same compute. The law further shows that at fixed model size, the compute-optimal loop count and training-token budget both grow with compute. When model size is also free, the law identifies two fully trained loops as the best looped setting. Experimentally, this setting achieves lower validation loss than the compute-optimal non-looped model with about 27% fewer non-embedding parameters and only 8% more training compute.

papers.title_en: Asymmetric Looped Transformers: Fixed Global Representations for an Iterative Decoder
papers.authors: Cheng Liang, Tengfei Zhang, Wenjie DU, Jianyu Wu, Changlian Ma, Shuchen Pu, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang, Zhouhan Lin
papers.evidence: 非对称循环Transformer用权重共享的循环解码器在迭代中复用同一组层
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer通过反复应用共享层提升有效深度，但全栈循环把上下文构建与状态精炼混在同一递归计算中，角色划分不清。作者提出非对称循环Transformer，用单遍因果编码器产生跨迭代固定的全局KV缓存，再由权重共享的循环解码器从演化状态生成局部KV并联合注意力。这样每次更新都能复用固定全局表示，在参数效率与迭代精炼之间取得更好平衡。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying shared layers, offering a way to scale computation without increasing parameter count. However, full-stack looping places context construction and iterative state refinement within the same recurrent computation, without explicitly distinguishing their roles. We introduce the Asymmetric Looped Transformer (AsymLoop), which separates single-pass context encoding from recurrent state refinement. A single-pass causal encoder produces layer-specific Global key-value (KV) caches that remain fixed across iterations, while a weight-tied recurrent decoder generates Local KV from its evolving state. Joint attention over both sources under a single softmax allows each update to integrate persistent contextual information with the current intermediate state. For training, we apply a heavy-tail-guided layerwise learning-rate method to the encoder and decoder. Experiments on FineWeb-Edu across four model scales, from 60M to 1B, show consistently lower validation perplexity and higher average downstream accuracy than Full Loop under matched effective depth and training token budgets. At 1B, AsymLoop improves average zero-shot accuracy across seven commonsense reasoning benchmarks from 49.58% to 50.85%. Further experiments extend these benefits to longer training budgets, an OLMo-style backbone, and sparse mixture-of-experts models. These results support asymmetric context encoding and state refinement as an effective design for recurrent language models.

papers.title_en: LSTM-Style Looped Transformers with Shared KV Caches
papers.authors: Andreas Kirsch
papers.evidence: 复用绑定权重并在循环核心共享KV缓存的LSTM风格循环Transformer
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer通过复用权重以更少参数完成深层计算，但缓存管理仍是挑战。作者研究一种LSTM风格Transformer，在循环核心中共享单一键值缓存，宽度1024时参数比非绑定对照少40.4%，持久缓存集由十五降至四。针对并行训练与续写训练缓存不一致，加入一致性损失消除81%至89%的续写损失惩罚，提升了共享缓存的实用性。
papers.abstract_en: Recurrent transformers reuse weights to perform deep computation with fewer parameters. We study an LSTM-style transformer that also shares one key--value cache across its recurrent core. At width 1024, it uses 40.4% fewer parameters than an untied control at nearly matched forward FLOPs, and reduces persistent cache sets from fifteen to four. Parallel training supplies cache entries from a standard-attention pass, whereas continuation reads entries produced recursively using shared attention. We address this mismatch by aligning the two training passes' cache entries with a consistency loss during the final 10% of a fixed training-token budget. Across three model widths on FineWeb, this removes 81--89% of the continuation-loss penalty relative to full-cache evaluation. The improvement replicates on disjoint documents for two training seeds. Across four widths and 1.05--4.19B training tokens, the loss cost of weight tying is smallest at lower token budgets, suggesting an opportunity to use recurrent computation when data and model storage are limited.

papers.title_en: One Model, Two Paths: Balancing Single-Pass and Looped Performance in Language Models
papers.authors: Jiarun Shen, Lei Zhao, Xiao Li
papers.evidence: 复用中间层共享权重实现语言模型循环推理
papers.tldr: 重复 Transformer 层可在不增加参数的前提下提升语言模型性能，但由于两条路径共享权重，改进循环预测会损害单次推理质量。作者研究对单次与循环输出同时加权监督的联合训练策略，并借助冻结的原始模型提供引导。实验表明联合监督相比仅循环训练显著减少单次性能退化，同时保留循环带来的增益，为双路径推理模型提供了可行训练方案。
papers.abstract_en: Repeating Transformer layers can improve language-model performance without adding parameters. A pretrained model can be adapted to support both single-pass and looped inference by reusing middle-layer weights for additional computation. Because both paths share weights, training to improve looped predictions can degrade single-pass quality. We study joint training strategies using weighted losses on both outputs, with guidance from the frozen original model. Joint supervision substantially reduces single-pass degradation compared to looped-only training, while preserving looped gains over ordinary continued training. Most of this benefit comes from adjusting the single-pass loss weight, with guidance from the frozen original model further improving the looped output. With validation-selected weights, our method preserves single-pass quality within a predefined tolerance of ordinary continued training while improving looped predictions.

papers.title_en: StateLoop: Persistent State for Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Feichen Song, Boyi Zeng, He Li, Shixiang Song, Yiqin Hao, Zitong Wang, Yizhou Yang, Yifan Liu, Ziwei He, Zhouhan Lin
papers.evidence: 为反复应用共享主干的循环Transformer增加逐token持久状态
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer通过反复应用共享主干实现参数高效的语言建模，但朴素实现只靠单一隐藏状态在迭代间传递信息，早期输出中有用的内容容易丢失。作者提出StateLoop，为每个token额外维护一个持久状态，用学习到的门控决定保留多少旧状态、吸收多少主干输出，并把更新后的状态投影回主干。该设计减少了参数需求并改善了跨迭代的信息保留，为循环架构提供了显式的跨轮记忆机制。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers offer a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling by repeatedly applying a shared backbone. Vanilla looped Transformers use each backbone output directly as the input to the next iteration. These outputs may contain information useful several iterations later, but retaining it across the loop depends entirely on the single hidden state. We introduce StateLoop, which maintains one additional persistent state per token to retain information across iterations. At each iteration, a learned gate controls how much of the previous state is retained and how much information from the backbone output is incorporated. The updated state is projected back and added to the backbone output for subsequent iterations and final prediction. This design reduces Pile perplexity and improves average accuracy across eight zero-shot tasks over Vanilla Looped. Its perplexity advantage over Vanilla Looped grows with trained loop depth, consistent with persistent state becoming increasingly useful as recurrent computation deepens.

papers.title_en: LoopFold: Parallelizing Recurrent Depth in Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Feichen Song, Boyi Zeng, Yiqin Hao, Shixiang Song, He Li, Yizhou Yang, Zitong Wang, Yifan Liu, Ziwei He, Zhouhan Lin
papers.evidence: 循环Transformer重复应用共享骨干用于语言建模
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer通过重复应用共享骨干提升每token计算量，但各次循环相互依赖导致解码延迟随深度增加。LoopFold将多个循环深度的计算折叠为针对同一前缀的并行批次，并用轻量预测器估计后续循环输入以提前启动。实验显示该方法在保持精度的同时显著降低延迟，缓解了并行循环边际收益递减的问题。其贡献在于为循环Transformer提供更优的精度与延迟权衡。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers increase computation per token by repeatedly applying a shared backbone, offering a way to improve language modeling and downstream task performance at a fixed backbone parameter count. However, each loop depends on the preceding loop, so increasing recurrent depth also increases decoding latency. Existing approaches include Parallel Loop Transformers, which reduce latency by overlapping loop computation across token positions, but yield rapidly diminishing marginal accuracy gains at larger depths. To address this challenge, we introduce LoopFold, which folds computation at multiple recurrent depths into parallel batches for the same token prefix. A lightweight predictor estimates inputs to later loops so they can start before earlier loops finish. A corrector then refines the outputs of these later loops using newly available results from earlier loops. All components are trained jointly using only the final next-token prediction loss. In experiments with 1.4B models, deeper LoopFold configurations achieve progressively higher average zero-shot accuracy across eight tasks, rising from 53.41% to 56.38%. Vanilla looped models and PLT show limited gains over the same depth range. Compared with a nine-loop vanilla model, LoopFold uses five sequential stages and additional parallel computation to reduce decoding latency by 46%.

papers.title_en: How to Loop Your Transformer: Loop Scaling, Specialization, and Parallel Inference
papers.authors: Chanakya Ekbote, Artidoro Pagnoni, Devendra Singh Sachan, Shruti Bhosale, Mike Lewis, Maryam Fazel-Zarandi, Shashank Rajput, Sujan Kumar Gonugondla
papers.evidence: 在解码器语言模型中反复循环复用同一Transformer层
papers.tldr: 循环通过反复应用同一Transformer或其中部分来复用权重，从而在固定参数下加深模型，但其收益取决于模型规模、训练算力还是推理效率约束占主导。作者从零训练稠密解码器Transformer，系统改变循环的部件、循环次数与循环间信息传递方式。实验覆盖最高10亿参数、1550亿token与32次循环，发现循环整个Transformer在固定参数预算下质量最佳。该研究为循环架构的设计选择与适用场景提供了系统性经验指南。
papers.abstract_en: Looping in transformer models reuses weights by repeatedly applying the same transformer, or parts of it, making the model deeper without increasing its parameter count. Whether looping is useful depends on which constraint dominates: model size, training compute, or autoregressive inference efficiency. We study these trade-offs jointly in dense decoder-only transformers trained from scratch, varying which parts of the model are looped, how many loops are applied, and how information is passed between loops. Our experiments span models with up to 1B parameters, trained on up to 155B tokens with up to $1.07\times10^{21}$ FLOPs and 32 loops. We find that looping the full transformer generally gives the strongest quality at a fixed parameter budget, whereas looping a middle block of layers gives a better return when training FLOPs are constrained. Adding loops is not uniformly beneficial: gains eventually saturate, reverse, or become unstable. This motivates asking whether forcing every loop to use the same weights limits the benefit of deeper looping. We address this by adding small loop-specific low-rank adapters that improve quality, with larger gains as more loops are added. Looped transformers also suffer a decoding slowdown proportional to the number of loops. Parallel Loop Transformers address this by passing hidden states between loops across adjacent token positions, allowing loop stages to run concurrently. However, in our experiments the original formulation does not consistently retain the quality gains of ordinary looping. We find that preserving the current-token embedding and separately normalizing it and the previous-token hidden state before combining them recovers strong performance across model scales and training budgets. Together, these results show that effective looping requires matching the design to the resource constraint and inference setting.

papers.title_en: UpLoop: Training Looped Transformers via Upcycling at No Extra Pretraining Compute
papers.authors: Cheng Liang, Tengfei Zhang, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang, Zhouhan Lin
papers.evidence: 以共享重复块训练循环语言模型的预训练调度
papers.tldr: 针对循环语言模型虽能通过共享权重重复计算增强推理、但每次额外循环都增加训练FLOPs成本的问题，论文提出UpLoop预训练调度。该方法从浅层Transformer起步，逐层复制已学层增长深度，并将早期节省的算力用于后期共享中间块的重复执行。结果在最终参数量、训练token数与训练FLOPs上与标准稠密基线完全对齐的条件下完成循环训练。这表明循环语言模型可零额外预训练成本获得重复计算收益。
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models can strengthen reasoning through repeated computation with shared weights, increasing execution depth without adding independent parameters. However, each additional pass increases training floating-point operations (FLOPs), making these gains more expensive to obtain. To address this cost, we propose UpLoop, a pretraining schedule that uses upcycling to train looped Transformers while exactly matching a standard dense baseline in final parameter count, total training tokens, and training FLOPs. Specifically, UpLoop begins with a shallow Transformer, progressively grows its depth by copying learned layers, and uses the computation saved early to support repeated execution of a shared middle block later in training. Experiments across model scales show improvements in language modeling and downstream performance, with the average score across 22 downstream tasks increasing from 22.99 to 27.52 at 1.3B parameters. These gains also extend to mathematical reasoning after supervised fine-tuning.

papers.title_en: ARLoop: Fully-Open Pre-trained Looped Transformers with Attention Residuals
papers.authors: Yuekun Yao, Yupei Du, Dawei Zhu, Huan Sun
papers.evidence: 带注意力残差的完全开源预训练循环 Transformer
papers.tldr: 循环 Transformer 通过重复共享层提升有效深度，但标准残差把跨循环深度的信息压缩为单一流，难以选择性地复用中间表示。作者提出基于注意力残差的 ARLoop 架构，让每层输入通过跨模型深度的注意力进行选择性聚合。实验发现循环 Transformer 并不需要完整残差历史，滑动窗口深度注意力即可匹配甚至超越全历史注意力。该工作还发布了完全开源的预训练循环模型，为循环大语言模型研究提供可复现基线。
papers.abstract_en: Looped transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared set of transformer layers, offering a parameter-efficient way to scale computation. However, standard residual connections aggregate information across recurrent depth into a single stream, providing limited control over which intermediate representations from preceding layers should be reused. In this paper, we introduce ARLoop, a looped transformer architecture based on attention residuals, where the input of each layer is selectively aggregated through attention over model depth. Distinct from standard transformers, we find that looped transformers do not require access to the full residual history: sliding-window depth attention matches or outperforms full-history attention at larger recurrent depths. Across controlled experiments with multiple parameter scales (140M and 370M) and recurrent depths (R = 1 to 5), ARLoop consistently outperforms prior residual designs for looped transformers. More importantly, we further scale ARLoop to 0.6B and 1.2B parameters under a realistic LLM pretraining recipe, demonstrating that the gains transfer to realistic pretraining, with particularly strong improvements on math and coding tasks. Our 1.2B model, pretrained on only 0.5T tokens with three recurrences, outperforms Huginn-3.5B (the only fully-open looped LLM as of our release date) across all evaluated tasks and is competitive with similar-sized non-looped models such as Qwen3.5-2B despite being trained on substantially less data.

papers.title_en: Loopback Transformer: Towards a Unified View of Residual Looped Transformers
papers.authors: Xuan Ouyang, Zefan Cai, Chenlong Zhang, Cheng Luo, Ke Wan, Junjie Hu
papers.evidence: 循环Transformer重复应用共享块并控制复用方式
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer通过重复应用共享块减少参数，但仅靠参数共享无法决定重复计算结果如何被复用。作者从深度记忆视角分析残差连接，指出整块输出混合了输入与更新，难以单独控制。Loopback Transformer将共享栈输入置于独立路径，并读取单独更新，用几何衰减调节输入强度与更新权重。该工作为循环Transformer的循环信息复用提供了统一的分析与控制框架。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers reduce parameter count by repeatedly applying shared blocks, but parameter sharing alone does not determine how the results of repeated computation are reused. We take the depth-memory view of residual connections and analyze which representation is stored after each block application and how later reads weight it. A full block output contains both its input and its new update, so weighting that output also reweights the history already carried by the input. Reading individual updates instead, with the shared stack's input kept on a separate path, gives separate controls over input strength, total update weight, and allocation across updates. The Loopback Transformer implements these controls: geometric decay sets the total update weight and supplies a recency prior, and attention learns how to allocate that weight. On ClimbMix, Loopback reaches lower validation loss than standard Transformer baselines with 40-75% of their Transformer parameters (excluding token embeddings and the output head) at reference scales from 191M to 3B, with training tokens and executed depth matched. It also has higher mean accuracy over thirteen downstream tasks at 1.4B and 3B. At 191M, 374M, and 778M, it has the lowest validation loss and the highest thirteen-task mean among the standard Transformer and seven looped residual designs.

papers.title_en: Looping Deeper Without Growing the KV Cache: Recurrent Depth for Causal Encoder-Decoders
papers.authors: Jiaqi Leng, Minshen Zhang, Zhaofeng Sun, Yu-Yang Qian, Peng Zhao, Hao Zhang
papers.evidence: 通过重复层应用实现循环深度的循环因果编码器-解码器语言模型
papers.tldr: 循环语言模型可在不增加参数的情况下加深计算，但跨层跨轮的KV缓存严重限制服务批量。作者设计了循环因果编码器-解码器，将循环放在编码器中迭代精炼全局KV表示，实现零轮次KV增长。实验表明该方法既带来语言建模收益，又保持长上下文扩展能力。其意义在于为不对称堆栈的循环位置与方式提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models deepen computation without adding parameters, yet caching full-context key-value (KV) states across layers and rounds severely bounds serving batch size. We design a looped causal encoder-decoder (CED) that achieves recurrent depth with zero round-wise KV growth, addressing where and how to loop an asymmetric stack in which only sparse encoder layers generate global KV. We find that recurrence must be placed in the encoder to iteratively refine global KV representations rather than re-reading static decoder projections, which both drives language-modeling gains and preserves long-context scaling. Furthermore, training the encoder loop under stochastic recurrence depth induces a fixed-point equilibrium where every round losslessly shares the last round's KV cache. Compounding cross-layer and cross-round KV sharing, the resulting Looped CED matches an unlooped CED's minimal memory footprint and recovers 86-93% of a looped Transformer's gain with 1/6 of its global KV. To test serving at production scale, we loop the 552B-parameter DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash for 8 rounds on one 4xGB200 node: with per-layer and per-round KV the loop cannot fit a single 128K-token request, whereas Looped CED holds 36.8x less KV per token, fits 38 such requests (as many as the unlooped model), and serves 3.6x higher throughput on 8K-token prompts.

papers.title_en: Rectified Looped Transformer
papers.authors: Musheng Li, Jiawei Zhang, Ziyuan Liu, Yuantao Gu
papers.evidence: 改进循环Transformer中共享层块反复应用的反馈方式
papers.tldr: 循环Transformer通过反复应用共享层块来提升有效深度，是参数高效的语言建模方案，但现有方法直接把上一循环输出当作下一循环输入，导致隐状态尺度膨胀与扰动放大。作者提出整流循环Transformer（RLT），借鉴流模型的插值思想，在每次循环中把当前状态与其预测线性插值作为下一输入，使状态变化均匀分布在各循环上。理论分析证明在合理假设下RLT保持状态稳定，实验显示其语言建模表现优于直接复用式循环结构。该工作为循环大模型架构的稳定性设计提供了新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block, offering a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling. However, most existing works directly reuse each loop's output as the next's input, which can lead to hidden-state scale growth and perturbation amplification as recurrence deepens. We propose Rectified Looped Transformer (RLT), which redesigns feedback between loops using an interpolation schedule inspired by flow-based modeling. At each loop, RLT forms the next input by linearly interpolating between the current state and its prediction. Such interpolation distributes state changes across loops, encouraging a smoother trajectory from the initial input to the final output. Theoretical analysis proves that, under appropriate assumptions, RLT keeps state magnitudes uniformly bounded across loops and reduces the worst-case perturbation amplification. We evaluate RLT on language modeling corpora and downstream benchmarks. At matched training and inference depths, RLT consistently achieves lower perplexity than a standard looped Transformer, while exhibiting greater robustness to input perturbations and variance in inference depth. Consistent with the theoretical results, latent trajectory analysis shows that RLT maintains more stable hidden-state norms across loops, which also facilitates extrapolation-based decoding strategies. Notably, RLT achieves these gains without requiring additional trainable parameters or extra recurrent block evaluations, thus providing a simple yet more stable feedback mechanism for looped Transformers.

papers.title_en: Architectures and KV Replay for Depth-Recurrent Language Models
papers.authors: Lucia Licakova, Niklas Schmidinger, Lukas Hauzenberger, Sebastian B\"ock, Sepp Hochreiter
papers.evidence: 重复 Transformer 层堆叠的深度循环语言模型
papers.tldr: 深度循环通过反复应用固定计算块来提升有效深度，但共享注意力参数并不共享各次迭代产生的 KV 状态，导致自回归解码时显存随循环深度增长。论文在统一的深度循环框架下研究重复 Transformer 层堆叠的循环混合结构，用循环 mLSTM 或 Gated DeltaNet 块替换多数注意力层并保留周期性注意力锚点。进一步将循环限制在 Parcae 式专用工作区并引入 KV 重放，实验显示可在保持稳定性的同时显著降低解码显存开销。
papers.abstract_en: Depth recurrence increases effective model depth by repeatedly applying a fixed computation block. However, sharing attention parameters does not share the key-value (KV) states generated at different recurrence iterations, which causes memory growth with recurrence depth during autoregressive decoding. We study how to reduce this memory cost through architectural and cache-sharing approaches within a common depth-recurrent framework. We first study a looped hybrid that repeats a stack of Transformer layers, with recurrent mLSTM or Gated DeltaNet blocks replacing most attention layers and periodic Transformer attention anchors retained. We then restrict recurrence to a dedicated recurrent workspace in a Parcae-style architecture and test its stabilising adapter as a wrapper for the looped hybrid.
